title: EPFO UPI Claim Withdrawal & ₹5 Lakh Auto-Settlement Limit
summary: **UPI Withdrawal Mechanism:** Employees’ Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO) enabled claim withdrawals directly via Unified Payments Interface (UPI), operational...

items: **UPI Withdrawal Mechanism:** Employees’ Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO) enabled claim withdrawals directly via Unified Payments Interface (UPI), operational from **1 April 2026**.
**Auto-Settlement Limit Expanded:** Auto-settlement claim ceiling raised 5-fold from ₹1 Lakh ➔ **₹5 Lakh**, processed within a streamlined turnaround time of **3 working days**.

**Withdrawal Quantum:** Up to 75% of eligible provident fund balance withdrawable for non-contingency needs, and up to 100% for superannuation (at age 55), permanent disability, or voluntary retirement.

blocks.content: 🎯 Exam Angle → EPFO auto-settlement limit raised from ₹1 Lakh to ₹5 Lakh (settled within 3 days); UPI withdrawal live from 1 April 2026.
